subject: Re: Tuesday appointment
text: Hello, Thank you for your message about the appointment on Tuesday. After thinking it over, I can make that time work if we meet at the quiet café near the library rather than the busier corner branch. That spot may be easier to talk, especially if either of us arrives carrying papers. I can arrive ten minutes early and send you a message from the entrance if the tables are all taken. There is also a bench outside if the noise becomes uncomfortable. Please say if you prefer the original venue instead, and I will adjust. Until then, I will plan on the café and bring the notes we discussed. Sincerely
